title: Inter's Keeper Secret: Chivu Won't Say It, the Papers Already Have | Milan v Inter
description:
Inter's goalkeeper for the derby is picked — Chivu just won't say who.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=60

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 30 — Asked who starts in goal, Chivu said "Non lo so vedremo domani" — I don't know, we'll see tomorrow. He also said injuries leave him three center-backs plus Carlos, and that Thuram is fit.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport and Corriere dello Sport, via FCInterNews · Oct 31 — both expect Josep Martínez to start, with Ivan Provedel dropping to the bench and Pio Esposito alongside Thuram.
REPORTED · ANSA · Oct 30 — Marco Guida is appointed to referee Milan–Inter.

Milan v Inter, San Siro — 3:45 PM ET · 20:45 CET · Paramount+ and Telemundo.
